scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n serveur,interface -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test --if-present && npm --prefix web run test --if-present
